title: Beyond the polyo l: valorization of the derivatized isocyanate fraction after chemical recycling of polyurethane
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article

Marthe Nees, Matthew Porters, Muhammad Adeel, Lukasz Pazdur, Christophe M. L. Vande Velde, Pieter Billen
This review addresses the fate of isocyanate-derived fractions from PU chemical recycling. It highlights valorization routes beyond polyols, noting promising pathways but also technical, economic, safety and regulatory limits.
